jobs.title: Operations Manager Logistik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Mehr als ein Job

Im Kontraktlogistikteam bei Kühne+Nagel verantwortest du Lagerhaltungsvorgänge, wie z. B. die Kommissionierung von Waren. Dabei arbeitest du präzise und trägst damit nicht nur zum Erfolg deines Teams bei, sondern sorgst auch für ein reibungsloses Tagesgeschäft in unseren Lager- und Distributionszentren. Mit deiner Arbeit ermöglichst du z. B. die Lagerung und Lieferung von Blumen und frischen Zutaten für schönes Ambiente und leckeres Essen in deinem Lieblingsrestaurant. Logistik bei Kühne+Nagel ist mehr, als du dir vorstellen kannst.

‎

An unserem modernen Logistikstandort im Möhlin verantworten wir die Lagerlogistik für renommierte Kunden aus dem Pharma und Healthcare Umfeld. Als Operations Manager Logistik (m/w/d) verantwortest du den reibungslosen Ablauf aller Lagerprozesse und führst ein Team von bis zu 40 Mitarbeitenden. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Standortleitung stellst du die Prozesse sicher und treibst Effizienz durch KPI‑gesteuerte Prozessoptimierungen voran. Du gestaltest aktiv unser Kundengeschäft am Standort mit und entwickelst Strukturen, Abläufe und Mitarbeitende nachhaltig weiter. Werde Teil unseres Teams und präge die langfristige Entwicklung des Standorts mit. Klingt das interessant für dich! Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Wie du dich einbringst

  • Unterstützung der Standortleitung bei der Umsetzung und dem Nachhalten von qualitäts- und produktivitätssteigernden Maßnahmen
  • Sicherstellung und Leitung aller operativen Abläufe zur Erzielung höchstmöglicher Effizienz, anhand festgelegter Kennzahlen 
  • Eigenverantwortliche Implementierung neuer Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kunden und entlang der Unternehmensanforderungen
  • Ansprechpartner: in für unseren Kunden und persönliche Pflege der Kundenbeziehung
  • Einsatzsteuerung und Führung der Mitarbeitenden sowie deren weitere Förderung im Rahmen von Schulungsmaßnahmen zur Erhaltung und laufenden Verbesserung der Dienstleistungsqualität
  • Schwachstellenanalyse und Konzeptentwicklung neuer verbesserter Arbeitsverfahren 

Was dich auszeichnet

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännischer Ausbildung als Logistikfachmann/-frau mit eidgenössischem Fachausweis oder vergleichbar 
  • Fundierte Berufs- und Führungserfahrung in einer operativen Tätigkeit innerhalb der Kontraktlogistik, Erfahrung im Pharma Umfeld von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Qualitätsmanagement und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungssystemen
  • Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie flexibles/ -systematisches Denken und Handeln
  • Strukturierter, teamorientierter sowie selbstständiger Arbeitsstil mit einer hohen Eigenmotivation und Zuverlässigkeit
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was für dich drin ist

  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung: Profitiere von einem attraktiven Salär inklusive 13. Monatslohn
  • Perspektive: Schulungsangebote für fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung wie z. B. Sprachkurse und Entwicklungsprogramme
  • Rabatte: Diverse Vergünstigungen bei zahlreichen Kooperationspartnern aus den Bereichen Mode, Freizeit, Elektronik, Wohnen & Co.
  • Teamarbeit: Team- und Firmenevents

Wer wir sind

Logistik berührt jeden Aspekt unseres Lebens – von den Gütern, die wir täglich konsumieren bis zur Gesundheitsversorgung, auf die wir uns verlassen. Bei uns geht deine Arbeit über Logistik hinaus: Sie ermöglicht die kleinen und großen Momente des Lebens für Menschen auf der ganzen Welt.

Als ein global führendes Logistikunternehmen mit der Vision, unsere Welt weiterzuentwickeln, bieten wir dir ein sicheres und stabiles Umfeld. Hier macht deine Arbeit einen echten Unterschied. Ob die Lieferung von Lebensmitteln, die Entwicklung nachhaltiger Transportlösungen oder gesellschaftliches Engagement – deine Arbeit bewirkt mehr, als du dir vorstellen kannst.

descriptionByLocale.en:
More than one job

In the contract logistics team at Kühne+Nagel, you are responsible for warehousing operations, such as picking goods. In doing so, you will work precisely and not only contribute to the success of your team, but also ensure smooth day-to-day operations in our warehouse and distribution centres. With your work, for example, you make it possible to store and deliver flowers and fresh ingredients for a nice ambiance and delicious food in your favorite restaurant. Logistics at Kühne+Nagel is more than you can imagine.

At our modern logistics location in Möhlin, we are responsible for warehouse logistics for renowned customers in the pharmaceutical and healthcare sector. As Operations Manager Logistics (m/f/d), you are responsible for the smooth running of all warehouse processes and lead a team of up to 40 employees. In close cooperation with our site management, you ensure the processes and drive efficiency through KPI-controlled process optimizations. You actively shape our customer business at the location and develop structures, processes and employees sustainably. Become part of our team and shape the long-term development of the location. Sounds interesting to you! Then apply now! We look forward to seeing you!

How you get involved

  • Support of site management in the implementation and follow-up of quality- and productivity-enhancing measures
  • Sicing and management of all operational processes to achieve the highest possible efficiency, based on defined key figures
  • Self-responsible implementation of new processes in close cooperation with the customer and according to the company requirements
  • Contact partner: in for our customer and personal maintenance of the customer relationship
  • Operational management and management of the employees as well as their further promotion within the framework of training measures for the maintenance and ongoing improvement of the quality of service

jobs.description:
It's more than a job

In a travel agent role at Kuehne+Nagel, tasks such as arranging business travel, managing itineraries, or coordinating travel logistics certainly contribute to your team's success, but they also create meaningful experiences for people around the world. Because your attention to detail supports your colleagues to perform at their best, such as ensuring the timely and seamless transport of hearing aids and advanced medical devices that change lives. At Kuehne+Nagel, our work contributes to more than we imagine.

‎

As a Senior Travel Agent at Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in delivering professional travel services for employees, senior leaders, and executive stakeholders across our global organization. You will manage complex business travel arrangements, provide expert travel advice, and ensure a seamless travel experience while balancing cost efficiency, traveler safety, and policy compliance. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external travel partners, you will help enable successful business operations across our global network.

How you create impact

  • Coordinate domestic and international business travel, including flights, hotels, rail travel, transfers, and visa requirements.
  • Manage complex travel arrangements for senior leaders, board members, and VIP travelers.
  • Provide expert travel advice and identify the most suitable and cost-effective travel solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with Kuehne+Nagel's Global Travel Policy and approval processes.
  • Manage travel disruptions, cancellations, emergencies, and last-minute itinerary changes.
  • Liaise with travel management companies, airlines, hotels, and other travel suppliers to ensure excellent service delivery.
  • Monitor travel requests, bookings, and ticketing while maintaining accurate traveler profiles and documentation.
  • Analyze travel data and reporting, support travel-related projects, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

What we would like you to bring

  • Several years of experience in corporate travel management, business travel operations, or a similar travel services role.
  • Strong knowledge of airline fares, ticketing, hotel programs, and global travel processes.
  • Proven experience supporting senior executives and managing complex international itineraries.
  • Experience working with travel booking systems, Global Distribution Systems (GDS), and travel reporting tools.
  • Excellent customer service, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced international environment.
  • Proactive problem-solving mindset with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Fluent in German and English; additional languages are considered an advantage.

What's in it for you

At Kuehne+Nagel, you'll join one of the world's leading logistics providers, connecting people and businesses across a global network. As part of our Global Travel Services team, you'll play an important role in enabling seamless travel experiences that support collaboration, innovation, and business success worldwide.

• We offer an international and collaborative working environment where your expertise is valued, your ideas are welcomed, and your contribution has a tangible impact. If you are passionate about delivering exceptional service and enjoy working in a dynamic, people-focused role, Kuehne+Nagel offers exciting opportunities for professional growth and development.

Who are we

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

C'est plus qu'un travail

Dans un rôle d'agent de voyage chez Kuehne+ Nagel, des tâches comme organiser des voyages d'affaires, gérer des itinéraires ou coordonner la logistique des voyages contribuent certainement au succès de votre équipe, mais ils créent également des expériences significatives pour les gens du monde entier. Parce que votre attention aux détails aide vos collègues à s'acquitter au mieux de leurs tâches, comme assurer le transport en temps opportun et sans heurt des appareils auditifs et des appareils médicaux de pointe qui changent la vie. Chez Kuehne+Nagel, notre travail contribue à plus que nous ne l'imaginons.

En tant qu'agent de voyage senior chez Kuehne+ Nagel, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la prestation de services de voyage professionnels pour les employés, les cadres supérieurs et les intervenants de notre organisation mondiale. Vous gérerez des voyages d'affaires complexes, vous fournirez des conseils de voyage d'experts et vous assurerez une expérience de voyage transparente tout en conciliant rentabilité, sécurité des voyageurs et conformité aux politiques. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des intervenants internes et des partenaires de voyage externes, vous contribuerez à la réussite des activités commerciales de notre réseau mondial.

Comment créer un impact

  • Coordonner les voyages d'affaires nationaux et internationaux, y compris les vols, les hôtels, les voyages ferroviaires, les transferts et les exigences en matière de visa.
  • Gérer les voyages complexes pour les cadres supérieurs, les membres du conseil et les voyageurs VIP.
  • Fournir des conseils de voyage spécialisés et identifier les solutions de voyage les plus appropriées et les plus rentables.
  • Assurer la conformité avec la Politique mondiale sur les voyages et les processus d'approbation de Kuehne+Nagel.
  • Gérer les perturbations de voyage, les annulations, les urgences et les changements d'itinéraire de dernière minute.
  • Assurer la liaison avec les compagnies de gestion des voyages, les compagnies aériennes, les hôtels et d'autres fournisseurs de voyages afin d'assurer une excellente prestation de services.
  • Surveiller les demandes de voyage, les réservations et les billets tout en conservant des profils et des documents précis pour les voyageurs.
  • Analyser les données sur les voyages et les rapports, appuyer les projets liés aux voyages et contribuer aux initiatives d'amélioration continue.

  • Plusieurs années d'expérience dans la gestion des voyages d'affaires, les opérations de voyages d'affaires ou un rôle semblable de services de voyage.

  • Expérience éprouvée pour appuyer les cadres supérieurs et gérer des itinéraires internationaux complexes.
  • Expérience de travail avec les systèmes de réservation de voyages, les systèmes de distribution mondiale (SGE) et les outils de rapport de voyage.
  • Excellente compétence en matière de service à la clientèle, de communication et de gestion des intervenants.
  • Fort compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement international rapide.
  • L'état d'esprit proactif de résolution de problèmes avec un haut niveau de précision et d'attention aux détails.
  • Fluent en allemand et en anglais; d'autres langues sont considérées comme un avantage.

Chez Kuehne+ Nagel, vous rejoindrez l'un des principaux fournisseurs de logistique au monde, reliant les gens et les entreprises à travers un réseau mondial. Dans le cadre de notre équipe des Services de voyage mondiaux, vous jouerez un rôle important en permettant des expériences de voyage sans faille qui appuient la collaboration, l'innovation et le succès commercial dans le monde entier.

La logistique façonne la vie quotidienne - des biens que nous consommons aux soins de santé sur lesquels nous comptons. Chez Kuehne+Nagel, votre travail va au-delà de la logistique; il permet à la fois des moments ordinaires et spéciaux dans la vie des gens à travers le monde.

  • Verantwortung für Krankheits- und Unfalltaggeldfälle, inklusive Prüfung der Taggeldgutschriften sowie Berechnungen zu Sperrfristen und Ferienkürzungen
  • Arbeit mit verschiedenen HR-Systemen und Tools
  • Unterstützung bei HR-Projekten sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem HR Service Center und Payroll

jobs.description:
It's more than a job

At NACORA, the in-house insurance broker of Kuehne+Nagel, you play a key role in shaping modern employee benefits insurance solutions across the globe.

With your expertise, you help design and manage Employee Benefits global insurance programs in over 100 countries. The impact of your work goes far beyond administration—it directly contributes to the people experience at Kuehne+Nagel worldwide.

‎

You already bring strong experience in employee benefits and enjoy working in an international, dynamic environment? Then you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

How you create impact

  • Manage global insurance programs end-to-end: design, placement, renewals, client servicing
  • Shape and drive global employee benefits strategies including health, life, disability, pension, etc. aligned with business priorities
  • Steer renewal negotiations with insurers and coordinate oversee policy implementation to achieve optimal coverage, financial efficiency and long-term partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance and compliance frameworks aligned with local regulations and internal governance standards
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with insurers, partners and internal stakeholders across the organization
  • Deliver presentations, training sessions, and support strategic projects
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives including support to non-life global insurance programs where relevant
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation through participation in key projects and transformation initiatives

What we would like you to bring

  • Degree or professional qualification in insurance, finance, or similar
  • Extensive experience in employee benefits broking or consulting, ideally with international exposure
  • Strong knowledge of global employee benefits structures, international program management and market best practices
  • Proven negotiation, stakeholder and project management skills
  • Strong analytical skills with a pro-active and solution-oriented approach
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Fluent English; additional languages are a plus

What's in it for you

  • Attractive compensation package
  • Modern office with good public transport connections and free parking
  • Discounted public transport pass
  • Global career development opportunities
  • Employee discounts in fashion, leisure, electronics, home & more
  • A supportive team environment with regular team and company events

Who we are

Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.

As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.

We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

jobs.description:
It's more than a job

As part of the Contract Logistics team at Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in designing, managing, and optimizing solutions that keep goods moving efficiently. Whether you’re leading a team, engineering processes, or driving projects, your work ensures that our customers’ products are stored, handled, and delivered with precision. From everyday essentials to seasonal items, what we do in Contract Logistics impacts businesses and communities around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, your contribution goes far beyond the warehouse—it helps shape the flow of global trade.

‎

Join our National Information Systems Expert Team in Switzerland as a Blue Yonder WMS Specialist (m/w/d) and help shape the future of logistics.
You will work on diverse projects across multiple sites, supporting warehouse operations and distribution for leading global customers.
In this role, you act as the critical link between operations and IT – transforming logistics needs into smart system solutions. Your expertise will drive continuous improvement, ensure system availability, and enhance overall operational performance.

How you create impact

  • As a point of contact for our customer and operations, you’ll handle system-related inquiries and provide first-level support, including creating next-level tickets.
  • Your responsibility includes ensuring optimal functionality of our Blue Yonder (JDA) Warehouse Management and Transportation systems.
  • You’ll be involved in implementing projects within the system environment of our Warehouse and Transport Management Systems, including integrating external service providers and applications.
  • Analyze and optimize work/process flows related to the deployed systems, and contribute to process and solution design.
  • Customize the Data Warehouse and create reports.
  • Prepare and conduct user training and workshops.
  • Perform regression and new development testing.
  • Maintain online documentation of system processes, keeping it up-to-date.

What we would like you to bring

  • Advanced configuration knowledge of Blue Yonder WMS (JDA Discrete).
  • Professional background in warehousing or contract logistics.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, a strong customer service orientation, and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking, with a self-directed and structured work approach.
  • Effective English communication skills;
  • Knowledge of SQL and Moca.
  • 1st Level Support Experience

What's in it for you

At Kühne + Nagel, you are always part of a dedicated and dynamic team because great achievements can only happen together. Join us on our journey with the vision of enhancing our innovative logistics solutions even further. • We offer genuine professional and personal growth opportunities in a secure work environment.
